set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
from pathlib import Path
import math, json
W=H=1024
img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H))
p=img.load()
for y in range(H):
    t=y/(H-1)
    for x in range(W):
        u=x/(W-1)
        r=int(20 + 18*(1-t) + 5*u)
        g=int(65 + 75*(1-t) + 30*u)
        b=int(145 + 90*(1-t))
        p[x,y]=(r,g,b)
# soft glow
glow=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); gd=ImageDraw.Draw(glow)
gd.ellipse((520,80,980,540), fill=(80,190,255,80))
glow=glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(90)); img=Image.alpha_composite(img.convert('RGBA'),glow)
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
# sun
cx,cy,r=690,335,150
for a in range(0,360,45):
    rad=math.radians(a)
    x1=cx+math.cos(rad)*205; y1=cy+math.sin(rad)*205
    x2=cx+math.cos(rad)*255; y2=cy+math.sin(rad)*255
    d.line((x1,y1,x2,y2), fill=(255,214,54,255), width=30)
d.ellipse((cx-r,cy-r,cx+r,cy+r), fill=(255,206,46,255))
# cloud shadow + cloud
shadow=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); sd=ImageDraw.Draw(shadow)
sd.rounded_rectangle((210,515,815,760), radius=125, fill=(0,20,55,65))
shadow=shadow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(28)); img=Image.alpha_composite(img,shadow); d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
cloud=(246,250,255,255)
d.ellipse((230,455,500,725), fill=cloud)
d.ellipse((395,365,690,700), fill=cloud)
d.ellipse((585,465,825,715), fill=cloud)
d.rounded_rectangle((225,540,825,745), radius=105, fill=cloud)
# small rain accents
for x in (380,510,640):
    d.line((x,790,x-35,855), fill=(100,205,255,255), width=22)
img=img.convert('RGB')
out=Path('WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon.png')
img.save(out, 'PNG', optimize=True)
Path('WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/Contents.json').write_text(json.dumps({'info':{'author':'xcode','version':1}},indent=2))
Path('WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/Contents.json').write_text(json.dumps({'images':[{'filename':'AppIcon.png','idiom':'universal','platform':'ios','size':'1024x1024'}],'info':{'author':'xcode','version':1}},indent=2))
PY
